commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-<unset>}"; echo "GITHUB_RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-<unset>}"; echo "BASE_default"; git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD; ls .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh 2>/dev/null && echo vendored-present

BASE=$(.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch main) || BASE=""
[ -n "$BASE" ] || BASE=main
CUR=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null) || CUR=""
echo "BASE=$BASE CUR=$CUR"
git push -u origin HEAD 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
for f in .prflow/learnings/*.jsonl; do echo "$f: $(grep -c . "$f")"; done; echo total:; cat .prflow/learnings/*.jsonl | grep -c .

printf '%s' '{"pr":92,"signals":{},"diff":"@@x@@","diff_truncated":false,"workpad_body":"w","issue":{"comments":[{"a":1}]}}' | jq -c -f lib/clean-entry.jq | jq -c '{schema_version,ap:.analysis_provenance}'
printf '%s' '{"pr":93,"signals":{},"diff":null,"diff_truncated":true,"workpad_body":null,"issue":null}' | jq -c -f lib/clean-entry.jq | jq -c '.analysis_provenance'
printf '%s' '{"pr":94,"signals":{},"analysis_provenance":{"cohort":"backfill-2026-08-08","bundle_diff_present":true}}' | jq -c -f …[per-command-truncated]

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
